root_cause: The canonical Supabase Edge production authority was merged correctly but its GitHub production environment had no SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN. The workflow checked the credential before scope applicability and required event SHA to equal moving main exactly, so an unrelated later main commit could also invalidate an otherwise safe promotion.
prevention_rule: Resolve the exact Supabase function scope before credential enforcement; persist credential-readiness evidence without exposing secrets; fail closed only for applicable promotions; accept an older protected-main candidate only when it is an ancestor of current main and no Supabase function/config path changed after it; retain workflow_dispatch for exact-function replay after one-time credential provisioning.
